_readme: Disclosure text as rendered by each platform, per locale. Matching is
case-insensitive substring, and ONLY inside the disclosure containers named
in each site adapter's selectors.ts — never against page titles, captions or
article text, or a video *about* AI labelling would block itself.
Extra variants only add coverage: a wrong string is a missed detection, not a
false positive. Locales absent here fall back to 'en' and the popup warns that
VERIFY AGAINST LIVE PAGES before shipping: platform wording changes. The RU
strings in particular are plausible renderings collected from public docs and
need confirmation in a real RU-locale session (see TESTING.md).
Only list wording that is specific to synthetic/altered content. Deliberately
absent: YouTube's section heading 'How this content was made' and the
'Captured with a camera' value, because both also appear for content that is
NOT AI-generated — matching them would block camera footage.

_meta.note: No entry has been confirmed against a live page yet.

en: Sound or visuals were significantly edited or digitally generated
ru: Звук или изображение существенно изменены или созданы цифровым способом
